title: STAR WARS™ Makes Its Way to Discord
summary: For this year’s Power of the Force celebrations, we’re hyped to release a brand-new collection of Star Wars themed Avatar Decorations and Profile Effects!
body:
All of us love Star Wars™ in some way or another. Yes, that includes you — maybe you’ve seen every movie ten times over, or you’ve watched the latest season of one of the TV spinoffs. Or, you’ve been gaming for a long time and haven’t stopped talking about a certain fan-favorite Star Wars RPG from 2003… you know the one.

The love for Star Wars even spans the Discord galaxy, with communities out there discussing their favorite parts of the franchise (alongside your one friend’s unsettlingly-accurate Jar Jar Binks impression). That’s why we’re hyped to release something special for this year’s Power the Force celebrations: a brand-new collection of Star Wars themed Avatar Decorations and Profile Effects!

Defend the light side with Yoda alongside your profile icon, or give in to the dark side by enshrouding your entire profile with the looming aura of Darth Vader himself.

Force Move to the Shop on desktop

Every decoration and profile effect from our new Star Wars™ Collection was made in collaboration between Discord’s creative team and Lucasfilm, with their love of the space saga on full display.

When thinking of what would make the perfect profile effect, one specific moment our in-house Star Wars diehards couldn’t stop talking about *that* hallway scene at the end of Rogue One: A Star Wars Story — Darth Vader's red lightsaber cuts through the darkness of ship hallways, an ominous glow enshrouding him before he goes full Sith Lord.

Moments like these, ones that are talked about for years on end, were the types of memories we wanted to rekindle every time you visit a profile: feelings of bravery, heroism, fear, and inspiration from the characters you know and love. Each one will fit perfectly when you place them on your Discord profile.

So, say “hello there!” to the group chat when you wear one of the new decorations and effects with TIE fighters and X-wings, clashing Lightsabers, and more, with the following items added in the Shop:

Avatar Decorations: 

  • Lightsabers (two variants available)
  • R2-D2 on Tattooine
  • Space Battle
  • Millennium Falcon Hyperdrive
  • Yoda on Dagobah
  • Curious BB-8

Profile Effects :

  • Lightsaber Mastery (two variants available)
  • Entering Hyperspace
  • Darth Vader Arrives

The Star Wars™ collection is available starting today! Check ‘em out on desktop by clicking on the button below, or see them on mobile by opening the “You” tab on the bottom-right of the app, then tapping the “Shop” button. (It’s the one that looks like, you know, a shop) 

Force Move to the Shop on desktop

And don’t forget: Nitro members get a discount on everything in the Shop, including any decorations and effects gifted to their friends. 

If you happen to need help, you don’t need to seek aid from galaxies afar — just reach for this support article.
